title: In full: Rowan Atkinson on free speech
summary: Rowan Atkinson's speech at the launch of the Reform Section 5 campaign in Parliament in 2012. He argues against criminalizing insulting words and for answering speech with more speech.
why: Recommended as an eloquent defense of free speech against laws on offensive or insulting speech.

quote.text: Rowan Atkinson made an excellent speech on the matter back then [2]
